pairs.target: xiàshān de chē méiyǒu zuò bǎn , tǎ wéi zuòzài kōng càikuāng zhījiān , xī shàng bào zhe zìjǐ de xiǎobāo .
pairs.english: The downhill cart had no bench. Tavi sat between empty vegetable baskets with his small bag on his knees.
pairs.hanzi: 下山的车没有座板，塔维坐在空菜筐之间，膝上抱着自己的小包。

pairs.english: At his early departure, Pavo pursued him to the door, pressed a coin for pickles on him and warned him not to choose all stalks.
pairs.hanzi: 清早出门时，帕沃还追到门边，塞给他一枚买酸菜的钱，嘱咐别挑全是菜梗的。

pairs.target: chē chū le bái jiē , tǎ wéi biàn bǎ nà méi qián lìng bāo qǐlái , miǎnde gēn lù qián hùn le .
pairs.english: Once the cart left White Steps, Tavi wrapped that coin separately to keep it apart from the fare.
pairs.hanzi: 车出了白阶，塔维便把那枚钱另包起来，免得跟路钱混了。

pairs.target: lù bùquánshì shíjiē , chē zǒu de shì rào pō de kuān dào .
pairs.english: The route was not all stone stairs: the cart took the broad road around the slopes.
pairs.hanzi: 路不全是石阶，车走的是绕坡的宽道。

pairs.target: yǒu yíduàn yǔ láishí de jiù yìlù bìng zhe , tā kànjiàn shuǐqú xià de gǒng dòng , yòu kànjiàn yǐn mǎcáo páng duō le yígè wāixié de xiǎopéng .
pairs.english: For a stretch it ran beside the old post road he had come by. He saw the arch under the aqueduct and a new crooked shelter by the watering trough.
pairs.hanzi: 有一段与来时的旧驿路并着，他看见水渠下的拱洞，又看见饮马槽旁多了一个歪斜的小棚。

pairs.target: nà liàng xiè lúnzǐ de yán chē zǎo bú zài nàlǐ le .
pairs.english: The salt cart with the removed wheel was long gone.
pairs.hanzi: 那辆卸轮子的盐车早不在那里了。

pairs.english: The driver forbade him to stand on descents and called before each turn. He hugged his bag, swaying slowly with the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 车主下坡时不许他站起来，转弯前先喊一声。他抱紧包，随着车身慢慢晃。

pairs.target: yuè wǎng xià , fēng lǐ de cǎo wèi yuè dàn , dào huòzhàn yǐjīng néng wénjiàn shúxī de yān hé shī méi .
pairs.english: Further down, the grassy smell faded from the wind. At the freight station he could already smell familiar smoke and wet coal.
pairs.hanzi: 越往下，风里的草味越淡，到货站已经能闻见熟悉的烟和湿煤。

pairs.target: wǔhòu , tā tàshàng huī ào de cháng jiē , hūrán bù zhīdào gāi zǒu kuài háishì zǒu màn . bāo bú zhòng , jiāndài què bèi tā huàn le liǎngcì .
pairs.english: That afternoon, stepping onto Ash Hollow's long stairs, he suddenly could not decide whether to hurry or slow down. His bag was light, yet he changed shoulders twice.
pairs.hanzi: 午后，他踏上灰坳的长阶，忽然不知道该走快还是走慢。包不重，肩带却被他换了两次。

pairs.target: sè lā de mén kāi zhe . lǐmiàn chuánlái jiǎndāo luò zài mùbǎn shàng de shēngyīn , jiēzhe shì tā de yìshēng késou . tǎ wéi zài ménbiān zhànzhù , jiào tā .
pairs.english: Sela's door was open. Scissors clattered on a board inside, followed by her cough. Tavi stopped at the door and called her.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉的门开着。里面传来剪刀落在木板上的声音，接着是她的一声咳嗽。塔维在门边站住，叫她。

pairs.target: tā táiqǐ tóu , méi shuōhuà , xiān bǎ xī shàng de mùbǎn yíkāi . tā gǎnjǐn jìnqù fú , tā táishǒu pāi le yíxià tā de gēbo .
pairs.english: She looked up without speaking and moved the board from her knees. He hurried in to help; she tapped his arm.
pairs.hanzi: 她抬起头，没说话，先把膝上的木板移开。他赶紧进去扶，她抬手拍了一下他的胳膊。

pairs.target: " wǒ yòu búshì zhànbùqǐlái . " tā tíngzhù . tā fú zhe zhuō yán qǐshēn , zǒu dào tā miànqián , yòng liǎngzhīshǒu bǎ tā de liǎn zhuǎnguò láikàn .
pairs.english: “It's not as if I can't stand.” He stopped. Bracing herself on the table edge, she stood, came to him and turned his face with both hands to look.
pairs.hanzi:
“我又不是站不起来。”
他停住。她扶着桌沿起身，走到他面前，用两只手把他的脸转过来看。

pairs.target: " shòu le . " " yīfu hòu . " " yīfu hòu hái néng bǎ liǎn zhē shòu ? "
pairs.english: “You're thinner.” “The clothes are thick.” “Can thick clothes hide the fat on your face?”
pairs.hanzi:
“瘦了。”
“衣服厚。”
“衣服厚还能把脸遮瘦？”

pairs.english: Tavi laughed, and she laughed too, her hands still on his shoulders. After a while she asked if he had eaten.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑起来，她也笑了，手却还在他肩上。过了一会儿，她才问是不是已经吃过饭。

pairs.target: tā shuō lùshang chī le , tā biàn shuō nà yě dé zài chī yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: He said he had eaten on the way; she said he must have a little more anyway.
pairs.hanzi: 他说路上吃了，她便说那也得再吃一点。

pairs.target: wūlǐ bǐ tā jìde de liàng , yuánlái guà zài chuāng biān de jiù bùlián juǎn qǐlái le .
pairs.english: The room seemed brighter than he remembered: the old window curtain had been rolled up.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里比他记得的亮，原来挂在窗边的旧布帘卷起来了。

pairs.target: chuāngtáishàng liǎngkē cōng cháng dé yì gāoyì ǎi , pángbiān jǐ zhe sānzhī zhuāng suìbù de xiǎo wǎn .
pairs.english: Two spring onions, one tall and one short, grew on the sill beside three bowls of cloth scraps.
pairs.hanzi: 窗台上两棵葱长得一高一矮，旁边挤着三只装碎布的小碗。

pairs.target: tā hái méi zuòxià , xiān shēnshǒu pèng le pèng nàgēn gāo de cōng yè . " zhēn cháng zhème gāo . " " nǐ yǐwéi wǒ xiěxìn piàn nǐ ? "
pairs.english: Before sitting he reached to touch the tall leaf. “It really grew that high.” “Thought I lied in my letter?”
pairs.hanzi:
他还没坐下，先伸手碰了碰那根高的葱叶。
“真长这么高。”
“你以为我写信骗你？”

pairs.target: " yǐwéi nǐ chī le . " " chī guò . liú zhe gēn , hái cháng . "
pairs.english: “Thought you ate them.” “I did. Leave the roots and they grow again.”
pairs.hanzi:
“以为你吃了。”
“吃过。留着根，还长。”

pairs.target: tā shuōbùchū wèishénme , zhè jù huà ràng tā bǐ kànjiàn nàxiē xīn yèzi hái gāoxìng .
pairs.english: He could not say why, but that made him happier than seeing the new leaves.
pairs.hanzi: 他说不出为什么，这句话让他比看见那些新叶子还高兴。

pairs.target: zào shàng de guō lǐ shì dòu tāng . sè lā wǎng lǐ tiān le diǎn shuǐ , yòu cóng guàn lǐ jiá chū yìxiǎokuài xiáncài .
pairs.english: Bean soup simmered on the stove. Sela added water and took a small piece of pickle from a jar.
pairs.hanzi: 灶上的锅里是豆汤。瑟拉往里添了点水，又从罐里夹出一小块咸菜。

pairs.target: tā bǎ bāo fàngzài zìjǐ de jiù chuángbiān , fāxiàn chuángshàng pù zhe gānjìng bù , zhěngzhěngqíqí bǎi le yìpái bāo hǎo de kuàngyàng .
pairs.english: He set his bag beside his old bed and found clean cloth spread there with a neat row of wrapped mineral samples.
pairs.hanzi: 他把包放在自己的旧床边，发现床上铺着干净布，整整齐齐摆了一排包好的矿样。

pairs.target: " wǒ shuì nǎér ? " " nǐ huílái de tūrán , xiān gēn shítou shāngliáng . " tā méi liàodào tā jīntiān jiù lái .
pairs.english: “Where do I sleep?” “You came suddenly. Discuss it with the stones first.” She had not expected him today.
pairs.hanzi:
“我睡哪儿？”
“你回来得突然，先跟石头商量。”
她没料到他今天就来。

pairs.target: nàxiē kuàngyàng míngzǎo yǒurén lái shōu , tā shuō děng chī wán , liǎnggè rén yìqǐ yí dào zhuōshàng , búyòng lìkè máng .
pairs.english: Someone would collect the samples tomorrow morning. After eating they could move them to the table together, she said. No need to start immediately.
pairs.hanzi: 那些矿样明早有人来收，她说等吃完，两个人一起移到桌上，不用立刻忙。

pairs.english: Only at the table did Tavi notice the new wooden wedge under its leg. He had always used folded paper and replaced it when wet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐到桌边，才注意到桌脚垫了新木片。他以前总拿一块折纸塞着，湿了便换。

pairs.english: Sela said the neighbour's girl had helped find the wood. The old paper made better kindling than a wedge.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉说是邻家的姑娘帮着找的木片，换下的旧纸拿去引火，比塞在那里强。

pairs.english: The home had not waited for him before continuing to live. He felt a hollow he could not explain, and it was not entirely painful.
pairs.hanzi: 屋子没有等他回来才继续过日子。他心里有一点说不出的空，又觉得那空处不全是难受。

pairs.english: With soup served, Sela sat opposite and asked for the news he had not told on the road, from the beginning.
pairs.hanzi: 汤盛好了。瑟拉坐在对面，让他把路上没说的事从头讲。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān shuō zìjǐ néng liúxià , zhèngshì qiānzì yǐqián yǒu jǐtiān huíhuà , tā diǎntóu , shuō bó yà jīnwǎn guòlái , kěyǐ bǎ nà zhāng zhǐ yìqǐ kàn .
pairs.english: Tavi began with being allowed to stay and having several days before signing. She nodded: Boya would come tonight, and they could read the paper together.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先说自己能留下，正式签字以前有几天回话，她点头，说博娅今晚过来，可以把那张纸一起看。

pairs.target: tā běnlái yùbèi xiān niàn zìjǐ dài de xìn , tīng tā zhèyàng shuō , yòu juéde zìjǐ xiě de nàxiē huà tài zhèngzhòng .
pairs.english: He had planned to read his own letter first. Now those words felt too solemn.
pairs.hanzi: 他本来预备先念自己带的信，听她这样说，又觉得自己写的那些话太郑重。

pairs.english: Sela saw the paper corner in his bag and asked what it was. “For you.” She reached for it; he kept it, saying he would read it himself.
pairs.hanzi:
瑟拉看见袋口露出的纸角，问是什么。
“给你的。”
她伸手，他没递，说自己念。

pairs.english: The first sentence was about mountains outside the window, the second his roommates. At Pavo's wet ball beside his pillow, she turned aside laughing and nearly choked on soup.
pairs.hanzi: 头一句是窗外的山，第二句是寝室的人，念到帕沃把湿球放在枕边，她突然笑得偏过头，差点呛着汤。

pairs.target: " tā niáng zhīdào ma ? " " bù zhīdào . wǒ yě méi tì tā shuō . " shèngxià jǐjù bùnán niàn le .
pairs.english: “Does his mother know?” “No. I didn't tell on him.” The remaining lines were easier to read.
pairs.hanzi:
“他娘知道吗？”
“不知道。我也没替他说。”
剩下几句不难念了。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zìjǐ xiě wāi de zì zhǐ gěi tā kàn , tā bú rènde , yě háishì còujìn kàn le hěn jiǔ .
pairs.english: He showed her his crooked characters. She could not read them but leaned closer and looked for a long time anyway.
pairs.hanzi: 他把自己写歪的字指给她看，她不认得，也还是凑近看了很久。

pairs.target: zuìhòu tā jiāng xìn fàngzài tā shǒubiān , juéde tā dàodǐ gēn lùshang dàilái de qítā zhǐ bù yíyàng .
pairs.english: Finally he laid the letter beside her, feeling it was different from all the other papers he had brought.
pairs.hanzi: 最后他将信放在她手边，觉得它到底跟路上带来的其他纸不一样。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn , ā duó sòng shuǐ lái , zhàn zài ménkǒu bǎ tǎ wéi cóngtóu kàndào jiǎo , shuō yīfu méi biàn guì , zuò dé dǎo zhí le .
pairs.english: At dusk Ado brought water, looked Tavi up and down at the door, and said his clothes were no dearer but he sat straighter.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚，阿铎送水来，站在门口把塔维从头看到脚，说衣服没变贵，坐得倒直了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ná wǎn qù jiē shuǐ , tā què bǎtǒng wǎng pángbiān yí fàng , xiān wèn nàzhǎn bú màoyān de dēng dàodǐ kàn míngbái méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi took a bowl for the water, but Ado put the bucket aside and first asked if he had figured out the smokeless lamp.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿碗去接水，他却把桶往旁边一放，先问那盏不冒烟的灯到底看明白没有。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhǎo le gēn duǎn mùtàn , zài bāo kuàngyàng shèng de zhǐ bèishàng huà .
pairs.english: Tavi found a short piece of charcoal and drew on the back of leftover wrapping paper.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维找了根短木炭，在包矿样剩的纸背上画。

pairs.target: tā huà dé bǐ shàng huí de wǎn hǎoduō le , guǎnzǐ tōngxiàng nǎlǐ , zhàozǐ lǐmiàn wèishénme liàng , dōu néng shuō yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: He drew far better than his last bowl: he could explain something of where the pipes led and why it shone inside the shade.
pairs.hanzi: 他画得比上回的碗好多了，管子通向哪里，罩子里面为什么亮，都能说一点。

pairs.target: ā duó wèn dēng dǎo le zěnmebàn , tā tíngzhù , chéngrèn zìjǐ méi wèn .
pairs.english: Ado asked what happened if it fell over. Tavi paused and admitted he had not asked.
pairs.hanzi: 阿铎问灯倒了怎么办，他停住，承认自己没问。

pairs.target: " xiàhuí wèn . " ā duó shuō , názǒu nà zhāng huà , yòu bǎ shuǐtǒng tí qǐlái , " wǒ hái dé huíqù zuòfàn . "
pairs.english: “Ask next time,” Ado said, taking the drawing and lifting his bucket again. “I still have to cook.”
pairs.hanzi: “下回问。”阿铎说，拿走那张画，又把水桶提起来，“我还得回去做饭。”

pairs.target: mén guānshàng yǐhòu , tǎ wéi bāng sè lā nuó kuàngyàng .
pairs.english: After the door closed, Tavi helped Sela move the samples.
pairs.hanzi: 门关上以后，塔维帮瑟拉挪矿样。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhè liǎnghuí yǐjīng jiāo guò qián , yǎnqián zhè yìhuí shì lìngwài de , búyào bǎ zhuōshàng hái mòshōu zǒu de yě suàn chéng tóngqián .
pairs.english: She said two batches had already been paid for; this was another. The ones still on the table should not be counted as coins.
pairs.hanzi: 她说这两回已经交过钱，眼前这一回是另外的，不要把桌上还没收走的也算成铜钱。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zuìhòu yígè zhǐbāo pěng dào zhuōshàng , zuò huí chuángbiān . chuángbǎn zài shúxī de wèizhì qīngqīng yìxiǎng .
pairs.english: He carried the last paper packet to the table and sat on his bed. The boards creaked softly at the familiar spot.
pairs.hanzi: 他把最后一个纸包捧到桌上，坐回床边。床板在熟悉的位置轻轻一响。

pairs.target: tā shēnshǒu mō dào qiángfèng lǐkǎ zhe de yìxiǎo duàn xiàntóu , yuánlái hái zài nàlǐ , lā le lā , méiyǒu lā chūlái .
pairs.english: His hand found a short thread caught in a wall crack. It was still there; he tugged but did not pull it out.
pairs.hanzi: 他伸手摸到墙缝里卡着的一小段线头，原来还在那里，拉了拉，没有拉出来。
